question: Who among the following Indian cricketers holds the record of most number of catches taken by a non-wicket keeper while standing in the slip cordon, as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Dravid.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rahul Dravid** holds the record for the **most number of catches (210)** taken by a** non-wicketkeeper**. In the **509 matches he played for India**, he took a total of **406 catches.**
 
• **Rahul Dravid:**__
 __
 
• He holds the **record of most catches in Test cricket by a non-wicket keeper** and also the record of highest scoring partnership in Test cricket with **Sachin Tendulkar(6520 runs).**
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer who is often called** 'Mr. Dependable and The Great Wall'.**
 
• He made his international **ODI debut on 3 April 1996** against **Sri Lanka and his test debut on 20 June 1996 **against **England.**
 
• He has been felicitated with national awards like **Arjuna Award, Padma Shri, and Padma Vibhushan awards** and was inducted into the** ICC Hall of Fame in 2018.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Javagal Srinath**__

 __
 
• He is a former Indian Cricketer and currently an ICC match referee.
 
• He is the first Indian fast bowler to take more than 300 wickets in One Day Internationals.
 
• He is one of eleven bowlers who took 300 wickets in one-day international cricket, and the only Indian fast bowler to take 300 wickets.
 
 
 
• **Manoj Prabhakar**__
 __
 
• He is a former Indian Cricketer.
 
• He was a right-arm medium-pace bowler and a lower-order batsman.
 
 
 
• **VVS Laxman**__
 
 
• He is a former Indian international cricketer and a Former cricket commentator.
 
• He is known for his elegant stroke play.
 
• He is currently the Head of Cricket at the National Cricket Academy (NCA), and the head coach of the India Under-19 and India A teams.
